text:
The verdict is **fix**: the stored data is now right, but the "undefined" the owner saw on screen comes from the chat view, which this change didn't touch. The review is in `minion-minion-ask3-cards-by-id/review.md`.

**What's still wrong (fixes)**
1. **The view causes the on-screen "undefined".** `ext/Chat/v3/ChatV3.js:156` titles every card that isn't a dictation with the first words of `m.text`. Now a `{icon, title}` card shows as an empty, untitled card instead. Its icon, title and content are never drawn, and `ChatList.js:65` has the same gap. The change fixed the agent's read-back in `page_tools.js` and made `type:"Card"` load as a real Message, but not the drawing.
2. **Other type names still show "undefined".** The fix only covers the name `"Card"`. Any other name an agent guesses still loads as a bare Item with no text, so the view prints "undefined" again.
3. **"A ref to an existing item" was never done.** The owner named it in the ask, but no call, test or doc covers it.
4. **Turning a message into a card changes nothing on screen.** The test proves the data changes. But the view never draws a Reply on its own and ignores title and icon on replies.

**Smaller observations (notes)**
- `risk.md` says one of the three new seat-brief lines explains upgrading a message. No such line was added.
- The brief says to write no `type`, while the code accepts `type:"Card"` on purpose. One sentence would reconcile them.
- The test writes scratch folders into the live sessions store, which the dev server watches.
- The minion's folder has no task.jsonl, and the brief lives in the parent's `ask3-cards-by-id/` folder.
- The commit `cacdb7e07` is still on `worktree/qf-5`, not merged.

**What works:** in the qf-5 worktree, all three test files pass: `card-messages` (10), `chat-messages` (22) and `Chat.test` (26). Adding, appending, rewriting and reading a card by id all work in the stored data.

The verdict is **fix**. The feature works, but some docs are out of date and the task's own files were never committed. I wrote the review to `minion-minion-ask3-cards-by-id/review.md`.

**What works:** everything the owner asked for is met. A card gets an icon and a title, can hold a ref to an existing item, and returns its id. It can be appended to, rewritten and read by that id. An existing message can be upgraded into a card. The card titled "undefined" is fixed in three places: what an agent reads back, how a saved card loads, and what the chat view draws. All four test files I ran pass in the qf-5 worktree (14, 24, 22 and 26 checks). I could not re-run the browser test, because it needs a dev server for the worktree. The minion's log says it passed. Every point from the first review was addressed.

**Must change:**
1. **Chat v3 readme is out of date.** `ext/Chat/v3/readme.md` says nothing about cards drawing an icon, a title and content. Its test counts are old too (18 and 16).
2. **A comment in `Message.js` is now wrong.** Lines 9–10 say an unknown type name "falls back to Item.hydrate's rule". After this change, any unknown name loads as a Message.
3. **`risk.md` and `requirements.md` were never committed.** They sit untracked in the parent's `ask3-cards-by-id/` folder. The brief asked for `risk.md`, so one cleanup would lose it.

**Smaller observations:**
- **Subclass loading:** an untyped message now always loads as a plain Message, even when loaded through Prompt or Reply. Nothing calls it that way today, but keeping the old subclass behaviour would cost nothing.
- **List view drawing:** the list view (`ChatList.js`) draws card content with its own copy of the code instead of the shared helper. Because of that, a ref inside a card draws as an empty row there.
- **List view styles:** `ChatList.css` has no styles for the new card classes.

There were no screenshots, so I only judged the requirements and the wording.

The verdict is **fix**. Everything the owner asked for works except one live-update bug in the list view and an out-of-date readme. I wrote the review to `minion-minion-ask3-cards-by-id/review.md`.

**Must change:**
1. **The list view doesn't update live when something is added to a card.** `ext/Chat/list/ChatList.js:26` only redraws a message when the change event comes from a Message. Adding to a card's content sends the event from the card's content list, which I confirmed in the qf-5 worktree. So the new line only appears after a reload. Chat v3 already handles this case (`ChatV3.js:371`); ChatList needs the same check.
2. **The list view's readme is out of date.** `ext/Chat/list/readme.md` doesn't say the view now draws cards. It also doesn't say the view now uses a helper from the v3 folder (`../v3/placement.js`).

**Smaller observations:**
- **Reading a card back is partial.** An agent gets a card's title and icon back, but its content only as a count. It also only sees the last 20 messages (`page_tools.js:139`).
- **Comments mention past reviews.** Lines like "review finding 1/4" mean nothing to a later reader; they should explain the code instead.
- **The new readme bullet is hard to read.** It's one 150-word sentence (`core/Session/Chat/readme.md:28`).
- **The stricter loading is safe for existing data.** Recorded sessions only use the message types Message, Prompt, Ref and Reply, so no saved message loads differently.

**What works:** every fix from the two earlier reviews is in, including `risk.md` and `requirements.md`, now committed. Six test files pass in the qf-5 worktree. I didn't re-run the browser test (`ChatV3.test.mjs`). The three commits are still on `worktree/qf-5`, not merged, as the brief said.

There were no screenshots, so I only judged the requirements and the wording.

The verdict is **fix**. The card feature does everything the owner asked; the two must-fix items are a missing readme section and a false comment in a test. I wrote the review to `minion-minion-ask3-cards-by-id/review.md`. There are no screenshots for this task, so it covers only Requirements and Words.

**What works:**
- An agent can add a card with an icon and a title, append to it, rewrite it, and read it back by its id, including an older card past the last 20 messages.
- A card's content can hold a ref to another item.
- An existing message can be upgraded into a card in place.
- The "undefined" title is fixed: an unknown message type like `"Card"` used to load as a blank item, and the read-back turned its missing text into the word "undefined".
- Every fix asked for in the three earlier reviews is in, at `80fb10838` on `worktree/qf-5`, and nothing is merged.
- I re-ran two of the tests in that worktree: 16/16 and 24/24. I couldn't re-run the two browser tests, because the worktree has no dev server.

**Must change:**
1. **The session readme doesn't say how to read a card back.** Its section on what the `item` tool returns (`core/Session/readme.md:120`) has no row for `messages`, and doesn't mention the new read by id, `{messages:{"<id>":{}}}`. The code points readers at that section.
2. **A test comment is false.** `card-messages.test.mjs:41-43` says the item tool can't use a temporary folder, but `page_tools.js:17` reads `SERVEX_PUBLIC` for exactly that. Because of this, the test writes its scratch sessions into the real sessions folder, and a killed run leaves junk there.

**Worth a look:**
- Comments that cite earlier review rounds ("review finding 1/4") are still in four test files, although the last round's log says they were removed.
- The new ChatList test can leave its fixture copy behind if the browser fails to start, and that copy isn't gitignored.
- The same test waits for a CSS class that doesn't exist and hides the timeout, which wastes up to 8 seconds per run.
- Servex's `item` tool now imports `note_view` from Chat v3's `placement.js`. Only a code comment records that this file must stay usable outside a browser.
